NodesRef SelectorQuery.exec(function callback)

Execute all requests. The request results form an array based on the request sequence and are returned in the first parameter of callback.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function.

Return Value

NodesRef

Sample Code

Page({
  onCreateSelectorQuery() {
    ma.createSelectorQuery()
      .select('test1').boundingClientRect()
      .select('test2').boundingClientRect()
      .selectAll('.all').boundingClientRect()
      .exec((res) => {
          console.log(res);
      });
  }
});
